 Wolves team news: Armstrong and Trippier return as Peixoto makes five changes 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Wolves have made five changes for the visit of Watford on Saturday, as Cesar Peixoto looks to sharpen their home form.
 According to ExpressAndStar.com, fit-again striker Adam Armstrong returns after missing the last two matches with a back injury.
 OneFootball Videos
 Kieran Trippier is also back after a groin problem, while Fer Lopez does not start and is named among the substitutes.
 Nasser Djiga is absent from the squad, and Yerson Mosquera makes his first start since the opening-night draw with Blackburn.
 Jean-Ricner Bellegarde and Jordan James also come in, with James making only his second Championship start since joining on loan from Rennes.
 Wolves starting line-up: Sa, Trippier, Mosquera, Krejci, Bueno, Andre, Munetsi, Bellegarde, James, Said, Armstrong. Bench: Neave, Doyle, Chirewa, Toti, Lopez, Mane, Tchatchoua, Rawlings, Virginia, goalkeeper.
 Wolves have taken just one point from their past two matches at Molineux.
 Source: ExpressAndStar.com
